subject: Q: is "set_zero_all_adjuncts() defined but not used" an important warning?

messages.author: 4b681bcd9d4d425d
messages.subject: Q: is "set_zero_all_adjuncts() defined but not used" an important warning?
parts:
Hi,

I rewrote some code for my complex diffeq model in my Model block (changing how I loop through, using one loop with conditionals instead of different loops), but the algebraic relationships should be all the same. I may have screwed that up, but I didn't think so. (I'll see what the output looks like, I guess.)

But now I'm getting the following warning from the compiler, and I'm not sure if it indicates something is wrong :( 

... /set_zero_all_adjoints.hpp:14:17: warning: 'void stan::math::set_zero_all_adjoints()' defined but not used [-Wunused-function]

The function is discussed in Bob et al's paper, but I don't understand it;
https://arxiv.org/pdf/1509.07164.pdf

Is this a red flag, or irrelevant?

Cheers,
David
